title: form layout: a `repeater` field on `span: 'auto'` gets one cell, though the spec says wide types reach the full row
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a declared contract not honoured, found by a review) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7202175363 on PR #37672, escalated out-of-diff; read from the tree on `main`, not yet run)

## What happens

The form field `span` docblock in the spec says a wide field type on `span: 'auto'` reaches the full row. A `repeater` field is one of those wide types, but both form renderers give it one cell: `field-type-alias.ts` maps `repeater` to `field:object`, and `field:object` is not on the wide list the auto-span resolver reads (`resolveColSpan` / `applyAutoColSpan` in `@object-ui/plugin-form`). This predates #37672, which made the named-form page use the same resolver as the record form, so both surfaces agree on the wrong answer.

reach: not yet measured. First step: render a two-column form with a `repeater` field and no `span` on the record form and on `/forms/NAME`.

## Expected

A `repeater` on `span: 'auto'` takes the full row on both renderers, as the docblock says, with a pin per renderer. If the docblock is the wrong side instead, the fix is to correct the docblock and say which wide types reach the full row.

Category ①: a declared layout contract that a renderer does not honour.
Priority: p3 (layout only; an author can set `span: 'full'` by hand).
Reader: the ux-lane dev who next edits the form auto-span resolver.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `repeater span`: see the search above this filing; no card names this.
Related: #37559, PR #37672.
